description: A navigation destination with an icon, a label and an active indicator. Adapts to the navigation drawer rail and bottom navigation.

props.active: Controls the active state. Takes precedence over the router and the parent group.
props.activeIcon: Icon shown instead of **icon** while the button is active.
props.baseColor: Text, icon and indicator color while the button is not active. Also used while active when **color** is not set.
props.badge: Badge on the icon. `true` renders a dot, any other value is the content. Accepts an object of [VBadge](/api/v-badge/) props.
props.color: Text, icon and indicator color while the button is active.
props.labels: Label visibility while stacked. With `selected`, only the active button shows its label.
props.rounded: Border radius of the active indicator and the hover/focus overlay.
props.stacked: Places the label under the icon. Set by v-navigation-drawer while in rail mode and by v-bottom-navigation unless `mode="horizontal"`.

slots.badge: Custom badge content. Requires **badge** to be set.
